name: Wearline
description: Soft rules worn through in the middle of the cell and left standing round the edges.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 6%, transparent 14%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 100%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 6%, transparent 14%), radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 100%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
